scripts.build: pnpm --filter adula build && pnpm --filter @adula/ui build && node scripts/ui-registry.mjs reference && pnpm --filter create-adulajs build && pnpm --filter @adula/reference build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter adula build && node scripts/ui-registry.mjs reference && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter adula test && node scripts/ui-registry.mjs reference && pnpm --filter @adula/ui test && pnpm --filter @adula/reference test && pnpm --filter create-adulajs test
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter adula build && node scripts/ui-registry.mjs reference && pnpm --filter @adula/reference dev
